changeSet.comment: 存量卡点数据集回填：有 active 索引的转可检索，其余转已入库等待重建
changeSet.sql: UPDATE cmr_dataset d SET status = CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cmr_index i WHERE i.dataset_id = d.id AND i.status = 'active' AND i.del_flag = 'F') THEN 'searchable' ELSE 'stored' END, stuck_reason = NULL WHERE d.status IN ('scoring', 'stuck', 'rejected');
